content:
A cinematic fantasy action trailer, 30 seconds, night setting, ancient Chinese village.

Open on a symmetrical wide shot down a stone-paved village path at night, thatched-roof walls lined with moss on either side. A colossal demon materializes from billowing black smoke at the end of the path — massive curved horns, a skeletal snarling face, hollow eyes, jagged teeth, two clawed hands reaching forward. (0:00–0:05)

Cut to a low dynamic tracking shot: a cloaked warrior launches a flying slash attack, his glowing blade trailing a long streak of fire through the air, sparks and embers scattering, motion-blurred cape whipping behind him. (0:05–0:10)

Cut to a wide static shot of a stone courtyard as fire and smoke erupt where the warrior lands, his silhouette visible inside the blast. A glowing golden ritual circle burns into the ground beneath him, radiating concentric light outward as smoke billows into the black sky. (0:10–0:15)

Cut to a fast tracking shot following the warrior from behind as he sprints past a thatched wall, a trail of yellow-gold sparks streaking off his cloak, camera shaking with the velocity, dusk-blue tones mixed with warm ember light. (0:15–0:20)

Cut to a low-angle symmetrical shot: the warrior stands with his back to camera in the center of the path, both hands raised overhead gripping a glowing golden blade pointed skyward. A massive circular glyph ignites above the blade tip like a solar seal, wind whipping his robe outward. (0:20–0:25)

Close on his back as he throws both arms open, splitting the frame in two: one side erupts into a churning wall of orange fire, the other blooms into a swirling purple-blue-green cosmic nebula, the golden blade-beam still firing straight up between them. (0:25–0:28)

End on the empty, misty stone path as dust and light settle into silence. (0:28–0:30)

Style: dark cinematic fantasy, high contrast lighting, volumetric smoke and particles, dramatic color grading (deep blacks, fire-orange, cosmic purple), motion blur on fast action, epic scale, wuxia trailer aesthetic.

Un tráiler cinematográfico de fantasía y acción, 30 segundos, ambientado de noche, en una aldea china antigua.

Abre con un plano general simétrico a lo largo de un sendero de piedra en la aldea, de noche, con muros de techos de paja cubiertos de musgo a ambos lados. Un demonio colosal se materializa a partir de humo negro arremolinado al final del camino: enormes cuernos curvados, un rostro esquelético y gruñente, ojos vacíos, dientes afilados, dos manos con garras extendidas hacia delante. (0:00–0:05)

Corta a un plano de seguimiento bajo y dinámico: un guerrero con capa lanza un ataque de tajo volador, su hoja resplandeciente dejando una larga estela de fuego en el aire, chispas y brasas dispersándose, la capa desenfocada por el movimiento ondeando detrás de él. (0:05–0:10)

Corta a un plano general estático de un patio de piedra mientras fuego y humo estallan donde aterriza el guerrero, con su silueta visible dentro de la explosión. Un círculo ritual dorado y brillante arde en el suelo bajo él, irradiando luz concéntrica hacia afuera mientras el humo se eleva hacia el cielo negro. (0:10–0:15)

Corta a un plano de seguimiento rápido siguiendo al guerrero desde atrás mientras corre junto a un muro de paja, dejando una estela de chispas amarillo-doradas que salen despedidas de su capa, con la cámara temblando por la velocidad, tonos azul crepúsculo mezclados con la cálida luz de las brasas. (0:15–0:20)

Corta a un plano simétrico en contrapicado: el guerrero está de espaldas a cámara en el centro del sendero, con ambas manos alzadas sobre la cabeza sujetando una hoja dorada y luminosa apuntando al cielo. Un enorme glifo circular se enciende sobre la punta de la hoja como un sello solar, mientras el viento agita su túnica hacia afuera. (0:20–0:25)

Primer plano de su espalda mientras abre ambos brazos de golpe, dividiendo el encuadre en dos: un lado estalla en un muro turbulento de fuego naranja, el otro florece en una nebulosa cósmica arremolinada de púrpura, azul y verde, mientras el rayo de la hoja dorada sigue disparándose recto hacia arriba entre ambos. (0:25–0:28)

Termina en el sendero de piedra vacío y cubierto de niebla, mientras el polvo y la luz se asientan en el silencio. (0:28–0:30)

Estilo: fantasía oscura cinematográfica, iluminación de alto contraste, humo volumétrico y partículas, gradación de color dramática (negros profundos, naranja fuego, púrpura cósmico), desenfoque de movimiento en la acción rápida, escala épica, estética de tráiler wuxia.

He intentado crear una escena de animación de acción dibujada a mano con Seedance

Crear con seedaance 2.5 en @weryai

Genera una película de animación de acción 2.5D dibujada a mano, a todo color, de 30 segundos, en formato 16:9.

Cada segmento comprime aproximadamente 3–4 de los 22 planos originales en un único beat continuo de 5 segundos, redactado como un bloque de prompt independiente que puedes introducir en una herramienta de generación de video, uno por uno.

SEGMENTO 1 (0:00–0:05) — Comienza la persecución

2.5D hand-drawn action animation, 16:9, full color, oil-paint rough brushstrokes, three-value cel shading, manga screentone, dry-brush speed lines, warm orange sunset light with blue-cyan shadows and pink-purple ambient reflections. Wide broken city road at a central vanishing point, embedded rail tracks on the left, foreground puddles, glass curtain wall on the left, massive concrete bridge pillar on the right, warm-toned high-rises in the distance, a giant static city statue far in the background.

Low camera hugging the road surface, tracking backward at high speed. A slender bare-handed fighter — narrow shoulders, thin arms, choppy white hair, dark-red matte markings under his eyes, loose black hooded jacket over a dark inner layer, loose black pants, lightweight dark shoes, hands empty — sprints at frame-left. Behind him at frame-right, a slender white-robed swordsman — short choppy black hair, sharp eye makeup, wide-sleeved white robe, high-waist sash, black gloves — pursues holding a single katana in his left hand, right hand empty. Rails, puddles, and buildings streak past in fast parallax.

Mid-shot: an ordinary gray sedan barrels out of control from behind them, tires wobbling, body bouncing violently on the cracked pavement, camera pushing forward along the road centerline.

End of segment: the swordsman slide-steps left to dodge the car, bringing the katana in front of his body; the fighter cracks the asphalt with a launching stride and vaults up over the hood, camera whipping into a lateral tracking move.

Hand-drawn uneven timing, twos and threes on ordinary movement, ones on the burst vault. No energy glow, no glowing blade — all light from sunset and reflections. High-speed electronic drums and distorted bass building steadily; tire friction and engine roar synced to the car's bounce.

SEGMENT 2 (0:05–0:10) — Airborne Clash

Same characters and road setting as established (black-clad bare-handed fighter, white-robed swordsman with single katana, broken city road with bridge pillar and glass curtain wall). 2.5D hand-drawn style, oil-paint brushstrokes, cel shading, screentone, warm sunset palette with cyan shadows.

Camera whips sharply upward. The fighter flips fully inverted above the moving car, his loose black jacket and pant cuffs whipping with delayed follow-through, body forming a clean bow-shaped silhouette against the sky. Fast push-in on his face: hanging upside down, white choppy hair sweeping across his forehead, a restrained dangerous smile, dark-red under-eye markings in flat matte texture.

Camera moves to over-the-swordsman's-shoulder, following upward. The fighter drives a heavy strike with an empty fist; the swordsman grips the katana with both hands in a horizontal block, blade flexing slightly under the impact. On contact: a single-frame monochrome inverted impact flash.

Camera orbits half a turn around the collision point. The fighter rebounds off the back of the blade, lands both hands on the car roof, and completes a fast forward roll. The swordsman never releases the katana.

Extreme key poses, smear frames on the flip, silhouette drag on the robe and jacket. Impact frame drains the music for an instant, then the downbeat snaps back in with clipped strings and industrial percussion.

SEGMENT 3 (0:10–0:15) — The Car Flips

Same two characters, same broken road location, massive concrete bridge pillar on the right side of frame. 2.5D hand-drawn animation, consistent color-plate misregistration and line boil, warm orange and pink-purple reflected light.

Lateral tracking shot: the swordsman slides low behind the bridge pillar, the katana blade briefly scraping a metal guardrail and throwing real sparks (no glow, physical sparks only); the fighter redirects the out-of-control sedan by stomping down hard on its roof, metal denting under the impact.

Camera darts out fast from the side of the pillar. The fighter kicks the rear of the car; the gray sedan flips sideways into the air, screeching and crumpling. The swordsman bursts out from behind the pillar and steps onto the edge of the spinning car door, robe sleeves snapping in the wind.

Camera whips sharply upward. The swordsman launches high off the spinning door, white robe and wide sleeves unfolding with delayed follow-through; mid-air he adjusts his two-handed grip and points the blade tip straight down at the fighter below.

Heavy weight on the car's spin and metal deformation despite both characters staying light and elastic. Bending metal and rushing wind sound effects synced tightly to the spin; bass line intensifies.

SEGMENT 4 (0:15–0:20) — Three Thrusts

Same fighter and swordsman, same road setting, now grounded in close-range combat near the road's center. 2.5D hand-drawn style, three-value cel shading, dry-brush speed lines on every strike.

Fast frontal pull-back: the swordsman lands and immediately delivers a straight thrust at the fighter's face. The fighter doesn't retreat — he shifts his head only centimeters to the right; the blade tip grazes his white hair, severing a few loose strands that drift away.

Lateral side tracking: a second thrust aims at his chest. The fighter hollows his stomach, drops a shoulder, rotates his torso — the blade slides along the front of his jacket, leaving one long thin slit in the black fabric.

fr.content:
Un trailer d’action fantasy cinématographique, 30 secondes, de nuit, dans un village chinois ancien.

Ouvrez sur un plan large symétrique le long d’un chemin de village pavé de pierre, de nuit, avec des murs aux toits de chaume couverts de mousse de chaque côté. Un démon colossal se matérialise à partir d’une fumée noire tourbillonnante au bout du chemin — d’immenses cornes recourbées, un visage squelettique grimaçant, des yeux creux, des dents déchiquetées, deux mains griffues tendues vers l’avant. (0:00–0:05)

Coupez à un travelling dynamique en contre-plongée : un guerrier en cape lance une attaque de taille en plein vol, sa lame lumineuse traçant dans l’air une longue traînée de feu, des étincelles et des braises se dispersant, sa cape floue par le mouvement fouettant derrière lui. (0:05–0:10)

Coupez à un plan large fixe d’une cour en pierre alors que le feu et la fumée explosent à l’endroit où le guerrier atterrit, sa silhouette visible dans la déflagration. Un cercle rituel doré lumineux s’embrase dans le sol sous lui, rayonnant des anneaux de lumière concentriques vers l’extérieur tandis que la fumée s’élève dans le ciel noir. (0:10–0:15)

Coupez à un travelling rapide suivant le guerrier de dos alors qu’il sprinte le long d’un mur de chaume, une traînée d’étincelles jaune-or s’échappant de sa cape, la caméra tremblant sous la vitesse, des tons bleu crépuscule mêlés à la chaleur des braises. (0:15–0:20)

Coupez à un plan symétrique en contre-plongée : le guerrier se tient dos à la caméra au centre du chemin, les deux mains levées au-dessus de sa tête, serrant une lame dorée lumineuse pointée vers le ciel. Un immense glyphe circulaire s’embrase au-dessus de la pointe de la lame comme un sceau solaire, le vent faisant gonfler sa robe vers l’extérieur. (0:20–0:25)

Gros plan sur son dos alors qu’il écarte brusquement les deux bras, divisant le cadre en deux : d’un côté, un mur de feu orange tourbillonnant explose ; de l’autre, une nébuleuse cosmique violette, bleue et verte se déploie en spirale, tandis que le rayon de la lame dorée continue de tirer droit vers le haut entre les deux. (0:25–0:28)

Terminez sur le chemin de pierre vide et brumeux, tandis que la poussière et la lumière retombent dans le silence. (0:28–0:30)

Style : fantasy cinématographique sombre, éclairage à fort contraste, fumée volumétrique et particules, étalonnage dramatique des couleurs (noirs profonds, orange feu, violet cosmique), flou de mouvement sur l’action rapide, échelle épique, esthétique de trailer wuxia.

J’ai essayé de créer une scène d’animation d’action dessinée à la main avec Seedance

Créer avec seedaance 2.5 sur @weryai

Générez un film d’animation d’action 2.5D dessiné à la main, en couleur, de 30 secondes, au format 16:9.

Chaque segment compresse environ 3 à 4 des 22 plans originaux en un seul battement continu de 5 secondes, rédigé comme un bloc de prompt autonome que vous pouvez envoyer un par un à un outil de génération vidéo.

SEGMENT 1 (0:00–0:05) — La poursuite commence

Animation d’action 2.5D dessinée à la main, 16:9, en couleur, coups de pinceau bruts à l’huile, cel shading à trois valeurs, screentone manga, lignes de vitesse au pinceau sec, lumière chaude de coucher de soleil orange avec ombres bleu-cyan et reflets ambiants rose-violet. Large route urbaine brisée avec un point de fuite central, rails encastrés à gauche, flaques au premier plan, mur-rideau en verre à gauche, énorme pilier de pont en béton à droite, immeubles aux tons chauds au loin, gigantesque statue urbaine immobile en arrière-plan.

Caméra basse collée à la surface de la route, travelling arrière à grande vitesse. Un combattant mince à mains nues — épaules étroites, bras fins, cheveux blancs hirsutes, marques mates rouge sombre sous les yeux, veste noire ample à capuche sur une couche intérieure sombre, pantalon noir ample, chaussures sombres légères, mains vides — sprinte côté cadre gauche. Derrière lui, côté cadre droit, un épéiste mince vêtu de blanc — cheveux noirs courts et hirsutes, maquillage des yeux marqué, robe blanche à manches larges, ceinture haute, gants noirs — poursuit en tenant un seul katana dans la main gauche, la main droite vide. Rails, flaques et bâtiments défilent en forte parallaxe.

Plan moyen : une berline grise ordinaire déboule hors de contrôle derrière eux, pneus vacillants, carrosserie rebondissant violemment sur le bitume fissuré, la caméra avançant le long de l’axe central de la route.

Fin du segment : l’épéiste effectue un pas glissé vers la gauche pour éviter la voiture, plaçant le katana devant son corps ; le combattant fissure l’asphalte d’une foulée de lancement et bondit au-dessus du capot, la caméra basculant dans un mouvement de travelling latéral.

Timing irrégulier dessiné à la main, en deux et trois sur les mouvements ordinaires, en un sur le bond explosif. Aucun halo d’énergie, aucune lame lumineuse — toute la lumière vient du coucher de soleil et des reflets. Batterie électronique rapide et basse distordue montant progressivement ; friction des pneus et rugissement du moteur synchronisés avec les rebonds de la voiture.

SEGMENT 2 (0:05–0:10) — Combat aérien

Même personnages et même décor routier que précédemment établis (combattant à mains nues en noir, épéiste en blanc avec un seul katana, route urbaine brisée avec pilier de pont et mur-rideau en verre). Style dessiné à la main 2.5D, coups de pinceau à l’huile, cel shading, screentone, palette de coucher de soleil chaud avec ombres cyan.

La caméra fouette brusquement vers le haut. Le combattant effectue un salto complètement inversé au-dessus de la voiture en mouvement, sa veste noire ample et les bas de son pantalon battant avec un retard de suivi, son corps formant une silhouette nette en arc de cercle contre le ciel. Gros plan rapide sur son visage : suspendu la tête en bas, cheveux blancs hirsutes balayés sur son front, sourire retenu et dangereux, marques rouge sombre sous les yeux à texture mate et plate.

La caméra passe en surl’épaule de l’épéiste, suivant vers le haut. Le combattant porte un coup lourd avec un poing vide ; l’épéiste saisit le katana à deux mains dans une parade horizontale, la lame se courbant légèrement sous l’impact. Au contact : un flash d’impact monochrome inversé d’une seule image.

La caméra effectue un demi-tour autour du point de collision. Le combattant rebondit sur l’arrière de la lame, pose les deux mains sur le toit de la voiture et termine une roulade avant rapide. L’épéiste ne lâche jamais le katana.

Poses clés extrêmes, images étirées sur le salto, traînée de silhouette sur la robe et la veste. L’image d’impact coupe brièvement la musique, puis le temps fort revient d’un coup avec des cordes hachées et des percussions industrielles.

SEGMENT 3 (0:10–0:15) — La voiture se retourne

Même deux personnages, même route brisée, énorme pilier de pont à droite du cadre. Animation 2.5D dessinée à la main, désalignement constant des aplats de couleur et vibration des traits, lumière réfléchie orange chaud et rose-violet.

Travelling latéral : l’épéiste glisse bas derrière le pilier du pont, la lame du katana raclant brièvement une glissière métallique et projetant de vraies étincelles (pas de lueur, seulement des étincelles physiques) ; le combattant redirige la berline hors de contrôle en écrasant violemment le toit du pied, le métal se cabossant sous l’impact.

La caméra surgit rapidement sur le côté du pilier. Le combattant donne un coup de pied à l’arrière de la voiture ; la berline grise bascule de côté dans les airs, crissant et se froissant. L’épéiste jaillit de derrière le pilier et prend appui sur le bord de la portière tournoyante, les manches de sa robe claquant au vent.

La caméra fouette brusquement vers le haut

映画的なファンタジー・アクション予告編、30秒、夜の設定、古代中国の村。

夜の石畳の村道を、左右対称のワイドショットで開く。両脇には苔むした茅葺き屋根の壁が並ぶ。道の先では、渦巻く黒煙の中から巨大な悪魔が姿を現す――巨大な湾曲した角、骨ばった獰猛な顔、虚ろな目、ギザギザの歯、前方へ伸びる二本の鉤爪の手。 (0:00–0:05)

低いダイナミックなトラッキングショットへカット。外套をまとった戦士が飛び斬りを放ち、発光する刃が空中に長い炎の軌跡を引く。火花と熾火が散り、モーションブラーのかかったマントが背後で翻る。 (0:05–0:10)

石造りの中庭を捉えたワイドの静止ショットへカット。戦士が着地した場所で火と煙が噴き上がり、爆風の中に彼のシルエットが見える。彼の足元には輝く黄金の儀式円が地面に焼き付き、同心円状の光を外へ放ちながら、煙が黒い空へと立ちのぼる。 (0:10–0:15)

後方から戦士を追う高速トラッキングショットへカット。彼は茅葺きの壁のそばを全力疾走し、外套から黄金色の火花の尾を引く。速度に合わせてカメラが揺れ、夕暮れの青いトーンに、暖かな熾火の光が混ざる。 (0:15–0:20)

ローアングルの左右対称ショットへカット。戦士は道の中央でカメラに背を向けて立ち、両手を頭上に掲げ、天空を指すように輝く黄金の刃を握っている。刃先の上には、太陽の封印のように巨大な円形の紋章が点火し、風が彼の衣を外側へ激しくはためかせる。 (0:20–0:25)

背中のクローズアップ。彼が両腕を大きく開くと、画面が二分される。片側ではオレンジの火の壁がうねりながら噴き上がり、もう片側では紫・青・緑が渦巻く宇宙的な星雲が花開く。黄金の刃のビームは、その間をまっすぐ上へ撃ち続けている。 (0:25–0:28)

最後は、霧の立ちこめる空っぽの石畳の道。塵と光が静かに落ち着き、沈黙に包まれる。 (0:28–0:30)

スタイル：ダークなシネマティック・ファンタジー、高コントラスト照明、ボリューメトリックな煙と粒子、ドラマチックなカラーグレーディング（深い黒、炎のオレンジ、宇宙的な紫）、高速アクション時のモーションブラー、壮大なスケール、武侠トレーラーの美学。

한 편의 시네마틱 판타지 액션 트레일러, 30초, 밤 배경, 고대 중국 마을.

밤의 돌로 포장된 마을 길을 따라 대칭적인 와이드 샷으로 시작한다. 양쪽에는 이끼가 낀 초가지붕 벽이 늘어서 있다. 길 끝에서 거대한 악마가 소용돌이치는 검은 연기 속에서 모습을 드러낸다 — 거대한 휘어진 뿔, 해골 같은 으르렁거리는 얼굴, 텅 빈 눈, 들쭉날쭉한 이빨, 앞으로 뻗는 두 개의 발톱 달린 손. (0:00–0:05)

로우 앵글의 역동적인 트래킹 샷으로 전환: 망토를 두른 전사가 공중 참격 공격을 날리고, 빛나는 검이 공중에 길게 불꽃 자국을 남긴다. 불꽃과 불씨가 사방으로 흩날리고, 모션 블러가 걸린 망토가 뒤로 휘날린다. (0:05–0:10)

돌로 된 안뜰의 와이드 고정 샷으로 전환. 전사가 착지한 지점에서 불과 연기가 폭발하고, 폭발 속에 그의 실루엣이 보인다. 그의 아래 땅에는 빛나는 황금 의식 원이 새겨지며 타오르고, 동심원 형태의 빛이 바깥으로 퍼져 나가고, 연기는 검은 하늘로 치솟는다. (0:10–0:15)

빠른 트래킹 샷으로 전환: 전사를 뒤에서 따라가며, 그가 초가지붕 벽 옆을 전속력으로 질주한다. 망토에서는 노란빛과 금빛 불꽃이 길게 흩날리고, 카메라는 속도감에 맞춰 흔들린다. 황혼의 푸른 톤과 따뜻한 불씨 빛이 섞여 있다. (0:15–0:20)

로우 앵글의 대칭 샷: 전사는 카메라를 등진 채 길 한가운데 서 있고, 두 손을 머리 위로 들어 빛나는 황금 검을 하늘로 겨누고 있다. 검 끝 위로 거대한 원형 문양이 태양의 봉인처럼 점화되고, 바람이 그의 로브를 바깥으로 휘몰아친다. (0:20–0:25)

그의 등을 클로즈업한 상태에서 두 팔을 활짝 벌리며 프레임을 둘로 가른다: 한쪽에서는 소용돌이치는 주황색 불의 벽이 폭발하고, 다른 한쪽에서는 휘몰아치는 보라-파랑-초록 우주 성운이 피어오른다. 황금 검의 빔은 그 사이에서 여전히 곧게 위로 발사된다. (0:25–0:28)

안개 낀 빈 돌길 위로 먼지와 빛이 가라앉으며 침묵 속에서 마무리된다. (0:28–0:30)

스타일: 어둡고 시네마틱한 판타지, 고대비 조명, 볼류메트릭 스모크와 파티클, 극적인 컬러 그레이딩(짙은 검정, 불꽃 오렌지, 우주적 보라색), 빠른 액션의 모션 블러, 장대한 스케일, 무협 트레일러 미학.

각 세그먼트는 원본 22개 샷 중 대략 3~4개를 하나의 연속된 5초 비트로 압축한 것이며, 비디오 생성 도구에 하나씩 넣을 수 있도록 독립적인 prompt 블록으로 작성되어 있습니다.

SEGMENT 1 (0:00–0:05) — 추격의 시작

2.5D 손그림 액션 애니메이션, 16:9, 풀컬러, 유화풍 거친 붓터치, 3단계 셀 셰이딩, 만화 스크린톤, 드라이 브러시 속도선, 따뜻한 오렌지색 석양빛과 파란-청록색 그림자, 분홍-보라색 주변 반사광. 중앙 소실점이 있는 넓게 갈라진 도시 도로, 왼쪽에는 매립된 철로, 전경의 물웅덩이, 왼쪽의 유리 커튼월, 오른쪽의 거대한 콘크리트 교각, 멀리 보이는 따뜻한 톤의 고층 빌딩들, 배경 깊숙한 곳의 거대한 정지된 도시 조각상.

카메라는 도로 표면에 바짝 붙은 낮은 위치에서 뒤로 고속 트래킹한다. 가느다란 맨손 전사 — 좁은 어깨, 마른 팔, 들쭉날쭉한 흰 머리, 눈 밑의 짙은 붉은 무광 마킹, 어두운 안쪽 레이어 위에 걸친 헐렁한 검은 후드 재킷, 헐렁한 검은 바지, 가벼운 어두운 신발, 빈 손 — 이 프레임 왼쪽에서 질주한다. 그 뒤 프레임 오른쪽에는 가느다란 흰 로브의 검객 — 짧고 들쭉날쭉한 검은 머리, 날카로운 아이 메이크업, 넓은 소매의 흰 로브, 하이웨이스트 허리띠, 검은 장갑 — 이 왼손에 단 하나의 카타나를 쥔 채 추격한다. 철로, 물웅덩이, 건물들이 빠른 패럴랙스로 스쳐 지나간다.

미디엄 샷: 평범한 회색 세단이 뒤에서 통제 불능 상태로 돌진해 나오며, 타이어가 흔들리고 차체가 금 간 포장도로 위에서 격렬하게 튄다. 카메라는 도로 중앙선을 따라 앞으로 밀고 나간다.

세그먼트의 끝: 검객이 차를 피하기 위해 왼쪽으로 슬라이드 스텝을 밟으며 카타나를 몸 앞에 가져오고, 전사는 발판처럼 강하게 디딘 보폭으로 아스팔트를 깨뜨리며 보닛 위로 뛰어오른다. 카메라는 옆 방향 트래킹으로 급히 휘어진다.

손그림 특유의 불규칙한 타이밍, 일반 동작은 twos와 threes, 폭발적인 도약은 ones. 에너지 글로우 없음, 빛나는 검 없음 — 모든 빛은 석양과 반사광에서만 나온다. 고속 전자 드럼과 왜곡된 베이스가 점점 고조되고, 타이어 마찰음과 엔진 굉음이 차의 흔들림과 정확히 싱크된다.

SEGMENT 2 (0:05–0:10) — 공중 격돌

이미 설정된 동일한 캐릭터와 도로 배경(검은 옷의 맨손 전사, 단검 하나를 든 흰 로브의 검객, 교각과 유리 커튼월이 있는 깨진 도시 도로). 2.5D 손그림 스타일, 유화풍 붓터치, 셀 셰이딩, 스크린톤, 따뜻한 석양 팔레트와 청록색 그림자.

Um trailer cinematográfico de fantasia e ação, 30 segundos, ambientação noturna, vila chinesa antiga.

Abra com um plano geral simétrico ao longo de um caminho de pedra na vila à noite, com paredes de telhado de palha cobertas de musgo em ambos os lados. Um demônio colossal se materializa de uma fumaça negra e densa no fim do caminho — enormes chifres curvos, um rosto esquelético e rosnante, olhos ocos, dentes serrilhados, duas mãos com garras avançando. (0:00–0:05)

Corte para um plano de acompanhamento baixo e dinâmico: um guerreiro de capa lança um ataque de corte voador, sua lâmina brilhante deixando um longo rastro de fogo no ar, faíscas e brasas se espalhando, a capa borrada pelo movimento chicoteando atrás dele. (0:05–0:10)

Corte para um plano geral estático de um pátio de pedra enquanto fogo e fumaça irrompem onde o guerreiro aterrissa, sua silhueta visível dentro da explosão. Um círculo ritual dourado e brilhante se incendeia no chão sob ele, irradiando luz concêntrica para fora enquanto a fumaça se ergue para o céu negro. (0:10–0:15)

Corte para um plano de acompanhamento rápido seguindo o guerreiro por trás enquanto ele corre passando por uma parede de palha, um rastro de faíscas amarelo-douradas saindo de sua capa, a câmera tremendo com a velocidade, tons de azul do entardecer misturados com a luz quente das brasas. (0:15–0:20)

Corte para um plano simétrico em contra-plongée: o guerreiro está de costas para a câmera no centro do caminho, ambas as mãos erguidas acima da cabeça segurando uma lâmina dourada brilhante apontada para o céu. Um enorme glifo circular se acende acima da ponta da lâmina como um selo solar, o vento agitando sua roupa para fora. (0:20–0:25)

Close nas costas dele enquanto ele abre os dois braços, dividindo o quadro em dois: um lado explode em uma parede turbulenta de fogo laranja, o outro desabrocha em uma nebulosa cósmica giratória roxa-azul-esverdeada, enquanto o feixe da lâmina dourada continua disparando reto para cima entre eles. (0:25–0:28)

Finalize no caminho de pedra vazio e enevoado, enquanto poeira e luz se assentam em silêncio. (0:28–0:30)

Estilo: fantasia sombria cinematográfica, iluminação de alto contraste, fumaça volumétrica e partículas, gradação de cor dramática (pretos profundos, laranja-fogo, roxo cósmico), motion blur em ação rápida, escala épica, estética de trailer wuxia.

A slender bare-handed fighter — narrow shoulders, thin arms, choppy white hair, dark-red matte markings under his eyes, loose black hooded jacket over a dark inner layer, loose black pants, lightweight dark shoes, hands empty — sprints at frame-left. Behind him at frame-right, a slender white-robed swordsman — short choppy black hair, sharp eye makeup, wide-sleeved white robe, high-waist sash, black gloves — pursues holding a single katana in his left hand, right hand empty. Rails, puddles, and buildings streak past in fast parallax.

Mid-shot: an ordinary gray sedan barrels out of control from behind them, tires wobbling, body bouncing violently on the cracked pavement, camera pushing forward along the road centerline.

End of segment: the swordsman slide-steps left to dodge the car, bringing the katana in front of his body; the fighter cracks the asphalt with a launching stride and vaults up over the hood, camera whipping into a lateral tracking move.

Hand-drawn uneven timing, twos and threes on ordinary movement, ones on the burst vault. No energy glow, no glowing blade — all light from sunset and reflections. High-speed electronic drums and distorted bass building steadily; tire friction and engine roar synced to the car's bounce.

Same characters and road setting as established (black-clad bare-handed fighter, white-robed swordsman with single katana, broken city road with bridge pillar and glass curtain wall). 2.5D hand-drawn style, oil-paint brushstrokes, cel shading, screentone, warm sunset palette with cyan shadows.

Camera whips sharply upward. The fighter flips fully inverted above the moving car, his loose black jacket and pant cuffs whipping with delayed follow-through, body forming a clean bow-shaped silhouette against the sky. Fast push-in on his face: hanging upside down, white choppy hair sweeping across his forehead, a restrained dangerous smile, dark-red under-eye markings in flat matte texture.

Camera moves to over-the-swordsman's-shoulder, following upward. The fighter drives a heavy strike with an empty fist; the swordsman grips the katana with both hands in a horizontal block, blade flexing slightly under the impact. On contact: a single-frame monochrome inverted impact flash.

Camera orbits half a turn around the collision point. The fighter rebounds off the back of the blade, lands both hands on the car roof, and completes a fast forward roll. The swordsman never releases the katana.

Extreme key poses, smear frames on the flip, silhouette drag on the robe and jacket. Impact frame drains the music for an instant, then the downbeat snaps back in with clipped strings and industrial percussion.

SEGMENT 3 (0:10–0:15) — The Car Flips

Same two characters, same broken road location, massive concrete bridge pillar on the right side of frame. 2.5D hand-drawn animation, consistent color-plate misregistration and line boil, warm orange and pink-purple reflected light.

Lateral tracking shot: the swordsman slides low behind the bridge pillar, the katana blade briefly scraping a metal guardrail and throwing real sparks (no glow, physical sparks only); the fighter redirects the out-of-control sedan by stomping down hard on its roof, metal denting under the impact.

Camera darts out fast from the side of the pillar. The fighter kicks the rear of the car; the gray sedan flips sideways into the air, screeching and crumpling. The swordsman bursts out from behind the pillar and steps onto the edge of the spinning car door, robe sleeves snapping in the wind.

Camera whips sharply upward. The swordsman launches high off the spinning door, white robe and wide sleeves unfolding with delayed follow-through; mid-air he adjusts his two-handed grip and points the blade tip straight down at the fighter below.

Heavy weight on the car's spin and metal deformation despite both characters staying light and elastic. Bending metal and rushing wind sound effects synced tightly to the spin; bass line intensifies.

SEGMENT 4 (0:15–0:20) — Three Thrusts

Same fighter and swordsman, same road setting, now grounded in close-range combat near the road's center. 2.5D hand-drawn style, three-value cel shading, dry-brush speed lines on every strike.

Fast frontal pull-back: the swordsman lands and immediately delivers a straight thrust at the fighter's face. The fighter doesn't retreat — he shifts his head only centimeters to the right; the blade tip grazes his white hair, severing a few loose strands that drift away.

一支电影感奇幻动作预告片，30秒，夜景，古代中国村庄。

开场为夜色中的对称广角镜头，俯瞰一条石板铺就的村道，两侧是长满青苔的茅草屋墙。道路尽头，一团翻涌的黑烟中浮现出一只巨型恶魔——巨大的弯角、骷髅般狰狞的面孔、空洞的眼窝、参差利齿、两只利爪般的手向前伸出。（0:00–0:05）

切到一个低机位的动态跟拍镜头：一名披风战士跃起发动飞斩攻击，发光的刀刃在空中拖出一道长长的火焰轨迹，火花与余烬四散飞溅，带运动模糊的斗篷在身后狂甩。（0:05–0:10）

切到石质庭院的广角静态镜头，战士落地之处火焰与浓烟爆发开来，他的剪影在爆炸中清晰可见。地面上，一道发光的金色仪式法阵在他脚下燃起，向外辐射出同心光环，烟雾翻卷着升入漆黑夜空。（0:10–0:15）

切到一个快速跟拍镜头，从背后追随战士奔跑，他冲过一面茅草墙，斗篷上甩出一串黄金色火花，镜头因高速而轻微震动，暮蓝色调与温暖的余烬光交织。（0:15–0:20）

切到低角度对称镜头：战士背对镜头站在道路中央，双手高举，握着一把发光的金色刀刃，刀尖直指天空。刀尖上方，一枚巨大的圆形符文如太阳封印般点燃，狂风将他的长袍向外掀起。（0:20–0:25）

近景对准他的背部，他张开双臂，将画面一分为二：一侧爆发出翻腾的橙色火墙，另一侧绽放出旋转的紫蓝绿色宇宙星云，而金色刀刃光束仍笔直向上贯穿其间。（0:25–0:28）

最后定格在空无一人的雾气弥漫的石板路上，尘埃与光芒缓缓沉落，归于寂静。（0:28–0:30）

风格：黑暗电影感奇幻，高对比光照，体积烟雾与粒子，戏剧化调色（深黑、火焰橙、宇宙紫），快速动作带运动模糊，史诗级尺度，武侠预告片美学。

Behind him at frame-right, a slender white-robed swordsman — short choppy black hair, sharp eye makeup, wide-sleeved white robe, high-waist sash, black gloves — pursues holding a single katana in his left hand, right hand empty. Rails, puddles, and buildings streak past in fast parallax.

Mid-shot: an ordinary gray sedan barrels out of control from behind them, tires wobbling, body bouncing violently on the cracked pavement, camera pushing forward along the road centerline.

End of segment: the swordsman slide-steps left to dodge the car, bringing the katana in front of his body; the fighter cracks the asphalt with a launching stride and vaults up over the hood, camera whipping into a lateral tracking move.

Hand-drawn uneven timing, twos and threes on ordinary movement, ones on the burst vault. No energy glow, no glowing blade — all light from sunset and reflections. High-speed electronic drums and distorted bass building steadily; tire friction and engine roar synced to the car's bounce.

SEGMENT 2 (0:05–0:10) — Airborne Clash

Same characters and road setting as established (black-clad bare-handed fighter, white-robed swordsman with single katana, broken city road with bridge pillar and glass curtain wall). 2.5D hand-drawn style, oil-paint brushstrokes, cel shading, screentone, warm sunset palette with cyan shadows.

Camera whips sharply upward. The fighter flips fully inverted above the moving car, his loose black jacket and pant cuffs whipping with delayed follow-through, body forming a clean bow-shaped silhouette against the sky. Fast push-in on his face: hanging upside down, white choppy hair sweeping across his forehead, a restrained dangerous smile, dark-red under-eye markings in flat matte texture.

Camera moves to over-the-swordsman's-shoulder, following upward. The fighter drives a heavy strike with an empty fist; the swordsman grips the katana with both hands in a horizontal block, blade flexing slightly under the impact. On contact: a single-frame monochrome inverted impact flash.

Camera orbits half a turn around the collision point. The fighter rebounds off the back of the blade, lands both hands on the car roof, and completes a fast forward roll. The swordsman never releases the katana.

Extreme key poses, smear frames on the flip, silhouette drag on the robe and jacket. Impact frame drains the music for an instant, then the downbeat snaps back in with clipped strings and industrial percussion.

SEGMENT 3 (0:10–0:15) — The Car Flips

Same two characters, same broken road location, massive concrete bridge pillar on the right side of frame. 2.5D hand-drawn animation, consistent color-plate misregistration and line boil, warm orange and pink-purple reflected light.

Lateral tracking shot: the swordsman slides low behind the bridge pillar, the katana blade briefly scraping a metal guardrail and throwing real sparks (no glow, physical sparks only); the fighter redirects the out-of-control sedan by stomping down hard on its roof, metal denting under the impact.

Camera darts out fast from the side of the pillar. The fighter kicks the rear of the car; the gray sedan flips sideways into the air, screeching and crumpling. The swordsman bursts out from behind the pillar and steps onto the edge of the spinning car door, robe sleeves snapping in the wind.

Camera whips sharply upward. The swordsman launches high off the spinning door, white robe and wide sleeves unfolding with delayed follow-through; mid-air he adjusts his two-handed grip and points the blade tip straight down at the fighter below.

Heavy weight on the car's spin and metal deformation despite both characters staying light and elastic. Bending metal and rushing wind sound effects synced tightly to the spin; bass line intensifies.

SEGMENT 4 (0:15–0:20) — Three Thrusts

Same fighter and swordsman, same road setting, now grounded in close-range combat near the road's center. 2.5D hand-drawn style, three-value cel shading, dry-brush speed lines on every strike.

Fast frontal pull-back: the swordsman lands and immediately delivers a straight thrust at the fighter's face. The fighter doesn't retreat — he shifts his head only centimeters to the right; the blade tip grazes his white hair, severing a few loose strands that drift away.

Lateral side tracking: a second thrust aims at his chest. The fighter hollows his stomach, drops a shoulder, rotates his torso — the blade slides along the front of his jacket, leaving one long thin slit in the black fabric.

Ground-hugging lateral tracking: a third low thrust aims at his abdomen. The fighter cross-steps outward and presses the flat of the blade aside with an open empty palm — never touching the edge — redirecting the tip past him.
